name: ARGUS golden evalset
description: Spec EV1: one scenario per distinct code path built across Stages 1-5 -- narrow routing (all three specialists), RAG, a clean broad analysis, a planted-contradiction analysis, a missing-company bounded retry, and an adversarial number-injection prompt. Deliberately 8 scenarios, not the spec's literal >=20 -- adk eval runs the real agent against the real Gemini API, and this project has lived under a 15-requests/minute free-tier ceiling all session; a broad scenario alone is ~16-20 calls, so a much larger set is not compatible with that ceiling. HITL pause/resume is intentionally not included here -- it was already live-verified manually in Stage 5B/C, and adk eval's static conversation format isn't a good fit for scripting a mid-run human reply.
